_comment: Non-Gmail mailboxes the digest can read, via fetch-imap.py.
THIS REPO IS PUBLIC: never inline a password here. Always use
'password_env' and set the real value in the cron .env
(/srv/crons/gmail-digest/.env on the VPS, which is outside the repo).
An address present here routes digest.sh down the IMAP path; anything
else goes to pp-gmail. Keys starting with '_' are ignored as accounts
only because no mail address starts with an underscore.
